columns.validationmsg: "Item flat Disc should be greater than zero"
columns.name: itemflatdisc

columns.validationmsg: 'Pack Qty should be greater than or equal to zero'
columns.name: packqtyforsale

columns.validationmsg: 'Bonus Qty should be greater than or equal to zero'
columns.name: bonuspackqtyforsale

table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.customicode, 
	itemname= item.name, 
	locksaleprice = dbo.item.locksaleprice,
	lockdiscperc  = dbo.item.lockdiscperc,
	currlistrow   = 0,
	stock         = 0.0000, 
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	qtysale=item.saleqty,
	bonus=item.bonusqty,
	totalstock= 0.0000, 
	purprice=0.00,
	recentpurprice=0.00,
	avgprice=saleorderdetail.avgprice,
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	assgcode  = 1, 
	updatesaleprice = 'N',
	saleordercode=saleorderdetail.saleordercode,   
	icode=saleorderdetail.icode,   
    gcode=saleorderdetail.gcode,
	itemflatdisc = saleorderdetail.itemflatdisc,
	RowID=Max(saleorderdetail.IDENTITYCOL),
	packunits = saleorderdetail.packunits,
	saleprice = saleorderdetail.saleprice,
	rate      = saleorderdetail.rate,
	SaleItemDescription =  saleorderdetail.SaleItemDescription,
	discperc  = saleorderdetail.discperc,
	itemcode = 0,
	retailprice=item.retailprice,
	rowgroup=MAX(saleorderdetail.rowgroup),
	packprice = saleorderdetail.packprice,
	unitsalestax=saleorderdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc=saleorderdetail.gstperc,
	packqtyforsale = saleorderdetail.packqtyforsale, 
	bonuspackqtyforsale = saleorderdetail.bonuspackqtyforsale,
	batch = saleorderdetail.Batch,
	manfdate = saleorderdetail.manfdate,
	Expiry = saleorderdetail.Expiry,
	Remarks=MAX(saleorderdetail.remarks),
	SaleOrderItemStatusCode=MAX(saleorderdetail.SaleOrderItemStatusCode),
	QuotationRowID=MAX(saleorderdetail.QuotationRowID),
	bonusqty= SUM(saleorderdetail.bonusqty),
	looseqty= SUM(saleorderdetail.looseqty)/*,
	Receiptqty = ISNULL((SELECT sum(qty) FROM ReceiptDetail WHERE Receiptdetail.icode = saleorderdetail.icode and Receiptdetail.saleorderrowid = saleorderdetail.rowid), 0),
	issuebonus = 0.0000*/
FROM  saleorderdetail,   
		item 
WHERE ( dbo.saleorderdetail.saleordercode = :ar_SaleOrderCode ) AND
		( saleorderdetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY
	item.customicode, 
	item.name, 
	dbo.item.locksaleprice,
	dbo.item.lockdiscperc,
	item.packingdesc,
	item.saleqty,
	item.bonusqty,
	saleorderdetail.avgprice,
	saleorderdetail.saleordercode,   
	saleorderdetail.icode,   
	saleorderdetail.gcode,
	saleorderdetail.itemflatdisc,
	saleorderdetail.packunits,
	saleorderdetail.saleprice,
	saleorderdetail.rate,
	saleorderdetail.SaleItemDescription,
	saleorderdetail.discperc,
	item.retailprice,
	saleorderdetail.packprice,
	saleorderdetail.unitsalestax,
	saleorderdetail.gstperc,
	saleorderdetail.packqtyforsale, 
	saleorderdetail.bonuspackqtyforsale,
	saleorderdetail.Batch,
	saleorderdetail.Expiry,
	saleorderdetail.manfdate
ORDER BY RowID

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum( ( ( looseqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc )) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )  for all)

objects.name: c_sumtaxval
objects.expression: sum( round( unitsalestax  * (Bonusqty + looseqty) ,2)  for all)

objects.name: c_sumgstval
objects.expression: sum( round( c_itemtotal  *  gstperc * 0.01,2)  for all)
